1365-2608-6582-8095.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Derevi and Aerith persist until end of turn.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Derevi.
When Derevi dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Aerith.
When Aerith dies, it triggers twice.
Resolve Aerith's persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Aerith trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each legendary creature you control, thus removing the -1/-1 counters from Aerith and Derevi.
Resolve the Hammerhead abilities from steps 2 and 5.
Repeat.
1365-2608-6582-8095.notes: The combo does not put +1/+1 counters on Derevi or Aerith, but does on any other legendary creature(s) you control.

533-6861-7839.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature or artifact.
Sawhorn Nemesis is naming you.
533-6861-7839.description:
Activate Makeshift Munitions by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 2 damage to Smaug due to Sawhorn Nemesis.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

4050-5851-7515.manaNeeded: {3}{W} plus the cost of the additional instant or sorcery
4050-5851-7515.notablePrerequisites: You can cast an additional instant or sorcery.
4050-5851-7515.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery by paying its cost.
Stormsplitter triggers, creating a token copy of itself.
When that token enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, becoming prepared.
Resolve the instant or sorcery from step 1.
Cast a copy of Scrollboost from exile by paying {1}{W} and unpreparing Spiritcall Enthusiast.
Both Stormsplitters trigger, creating two more token copies of Stormsplitter.
When a token enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, becoming prepared.
Resolve the copy of Scrollboost, giving one or two creatures +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing one Stormsplitter token, adding {W}.
Activate any mana source, adding an additional {1}.
Cast a copy of Scrollboost from exile by paying {1}{W} and unpreparing Spiritcall Enthusiast.
At least three Stormsplitters trigger, creating at least three more token copies of Stormsplitter.
When a token enters, Spiritcall Enthusiast triggers, becoming prepared.
Resolve the copy of Scrollboost, giving one or two creatures +2/+2 until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing two Stormsplitter tokens, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat from step 11 any number of times.
Once you have infinite Stormsplitter tokens, you may activate Phyrexian Altar any number of times, adding infinite mana.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-413-527-5434.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-413-527-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Selvala.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala enter, Slimefoot and Squee triggers once and Blasting Station triggers twice.
Resolve both Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee.
Resolve the Slimefoot and Squee trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

3617-5144-5913.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Pinnacle Monk and exiling Ephemerate.
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Pinnacle Monk
When Pinnacle Monk enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1171-1409-1753.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, casting a copy of Black Lotus by paying {0}.
Activate the Black Lotus token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Garth One-Eye by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Garth One-Eye enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.

1687-4050-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1687-4050-5972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

147-2511-7281.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-7281.description:
Cast Leonardo's Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Leonardo's Technique.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Leonardo's Technique, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Leonardo's Technique copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2511-7281.notes: If desired, you can cast Leonardo's Technique for its sneak cost instead, reducing the mana cost by {2}.

3532-3536-5078-6822.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat from step 2

2342-5465-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Doc Aurlock.
Repeat.

147-3269-3967.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-3269-3967.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-3269-3967.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

1069-5285-5499-6965.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
Luminarch Ascension has at least four quest counters on it.
1069-5285-5499-6965.description:
Activate Luminarch Ascension by paying {1}{W}, creating a 4/4 Angel creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Angel.
Activate the Angel by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Angels.

2043-4050-4365-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {2}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2511-5263-6243.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero as an Angel with flying.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

647-2034-3372-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
647-2034-3372-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality, adding {C}{C}.
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

261-2919-5641.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
261-2919-5641.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Suture Priest's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat from step 2.

654-1309-1541-2034-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Salvager of Secrets, adding {C}{C}.
When Salvager of Secrets dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Salvager of Secrets on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hit the Mother Lode by paying {4}{R}{R}{R}, exiling Salvager of Secrets from the top of your library and casting it without paying its mana cost, and creating five tapped Treasure artifact tokens.
When Salvager of Secrets and the Treasures enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers five times and Salvager of Secrets triggers once.
Resolve all Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Salvager of Secrets trigger, returning Hit the Mother Lode from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

341-2034-3831-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Circuit Mender, adding {C}{C}.
When Circuit Mender dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Circuit Mender on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Circuit Mender trigger, causing you to draw Circuit Mender.
Cast Circuit Mender by paying {2}.
When Circuit Mender enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

3169-4559-4659-4814.notablePrerequisites:
You conrol noncreature artifacts with a total mana value of 10 or greater.
"Mirran" chosen with Mirrodin Besieged.
3169-4559-4659-4814.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying at most {1}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When Metalwork Colossus enters the battlefield, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing the two Myrs, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1530-4447-4608.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is five or less.
You control at least five enchantments.
Assault Suit attached to Second Chance.
1530-4447-4608.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to not sacrifice it due to Assault Suit and take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

28-3611.description:
Nath of the Gilt-Leaf makes an elf warrior at the begining of your upkeep by making an opponent discard a card.
In main phase sacrifice the elf warrior making an opponent discard 2 cards, making two more elf warriors.
Repeat this step until all opponent have no cards in hand.
